## Triage: audit · p3 · `domain:server` · 2026-11-07T17:55Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- The cached `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` sends `Last-Modified` as the time of the read, not the item's own modification time. The header carries no information, and an `If-Modified-Since` revalidation always answers "modified". ETag revalidation works, so nothing is broken. It is also the cause of the #31171 flake, which was fixed in the test only.
- p3: a false but harmless header. Lane `domain:server` (`metadata-protocol` + `rest`). `finding` removed, `pm:queue`.
